application_credentials.description:
To connect your leak detectors you need your own Resideo developer app:

1. Open the [Resideo developer dashboard]({developer_dashboard_url}) and create an app.
2. Set the app's Callback URL to `{redirect_url}`.
3. Enter the app's Consumer Key as the Client ID and the Consumer Secret as the Client Secret below.
